name: CAMPR
description_en:
CAMPR is a product in the Project management category. Its directory profile covers Timeline View, Project Templates, Idea Management, Time & Expense Tracking, Task Management, Status Tracking, Resource Management, Requirement Management.

Additional listed capabilities include Project Planning, Project Portfolio Management, Percent-Complete Tracking, Milestone Tracking, Budget Management. These areas should be evaluated against the tasks, permissions and data involved in the intended workflow.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud) Desktop App (Windows, Mac). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large). API support is listed as NA. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: create, assign and track units of work; allocate people, time and other project resources; track significant project checkpoints; plan budgets and compare spending with allocations. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.
description_zh:
CAMPR 属于项目管理软件。第三方资料列出的功能包括时间轴视图、项目模板、创意管理、工时与费用跟踪、任务管理、状态跟踪、资源管理、需求管理。

资料还列出项目规划、项目组合管理、完成百分比跟踪、里程碑跟踪、预算管理。选择时应结合实际任务、使用权限和数据处理需求逐项评估。

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务） 桌面应用 (Windows, Mac)。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织。API 支持情况为未注明。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 另有持续免费方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：创建、分配并跟踪具体工作任务；分配人员、时间和其他项目资源；跟踪项目中的重要检查节点；制定预算并比较实际支出与分配额度。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
